name: Input
description: A single-line text field with a soft focus ring and a built-in error state.

type.description: Native input type (+ other native types).

aria-invalid.description: Set true for an error state (red ring). Pair with a visible message.

clearable.description: Shows a kubkit clear button when the input has a value. Also removes the native browser search clear affordance.

clearLabel.description: Accessible label for the clear button.

onClear.description: Called when the clear button is pressed. Use it to clear controlled values.

forbidden: Do not style height, border or colors via className; those come from tokens.
Do not use a bare <input> — use Input so the focus ring and invalid state stay consistent.
Do not convey an error with color alone; set aria-invalid AND show a message.
Always pair with a Label (htmlFor) — no unlabelled inputs.

responsive.note: ≥44px tall for comfortable tapping; prefer full-width inputs on mobile.
